name: Squad
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The 50 versus 50 tactical shooter built on communication and teamwork. Installs the Linux dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated, with Workshop mods.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="./linux64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"; exec ./SquadGame/Binaries/Linux/SquadGameServer SquadGame Port={{SERVER_PORT}} QueryPort={{QUERY_PORT}} beaconport={{BEACON_PORT}} FIXEDMAXTICKRATE={{TICK_RATE}} RANDOM=NONE -log

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Squad. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 403240) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously, and the Workshop mods asked for. Settings in
# SquadGame/ServerConfig and other mods are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-403240}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# Workshop mods named in Workshop items are downloaded and put in
# SquadGame/Plugins/Mods, replacing older copies of the same items; other mods
# there are left alone.
items="${WORKSHOP_ITEMS:-}"
if [ -n "$items" ]; then
    mkdir -p SquadGame/Plugins/Mods
    for id in ${items//,/ }; do
        echo "Downloading Workshop item $id"
        ok=
        for try in 1 2 3; do
            ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +workshop_download_item 393380 "$id" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
            grep -aq "Success. Downloaded item $id" /tmp/steamcmd.log && { ok=1; break; }
            sleep 5
        done
        [ -n "$ok" ] || fail "Steam couldn't download Workshop item $id. Check the ID, then reinstall."
        rm -rf "SquadGame/Plugins/Mods/$id"
        mv "steamapps/workshop/content/393380/$id" "SquadGame/Plugins/Mods/$id"
    done
    rm -f steamapps/workshop/appworkshop_393380.acf
fi
# The settings the Panel writes into Server.cfg at every start need a line
# each to replace; the rest of the file is the owner's.
cfg=SquadGame/ServerConfig/Server.cfg
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$cfg")"
touch "$cfg"
for key in ServerName MaxPlayers ShouldAdvertise NumReservedSlots AllowTeamChanges PreventTeamChangeIfUnbalanced EnforceTeamBalance; do
    grep -q "^$key=" "$cfg" || echo "$key=" >> "$cfg"
done
echo "Installed Squad build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Reserved slots
variables.description: Slots kept free for admins and players on the reserved list.

variables.name: Advertise
variables.description: List the server in the public server browser.

variables.name: Keep teams balanced
variables.description: Stop players changing to a team that already has more players, and balance teams when they're uneven.

variables.name: Tick rate
variables.description: The server's simulation rate, in ticks per second.

variables.name: Workshop items
variables.description: Workshop mod IDs, separated by commas. Reinstall to download them.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server queries use; give it an allocation.

variables.name: Beacon port
variables.description: The port the server list finds the server on; give it an allocation. The game also uses the port after the game port.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
